title: Enhancing Tabular Learners with Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2608.03565v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While modern tabular learners excel at capturing statistical patterns, they frequently operate in a semantic vacuum, treating textual features as discrete symbols, ignoring the rich semantics inherent in feature names or cell entries. We propose CASE (Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings), a novel framework that bridges the gap between the semantic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the statistical capabilities of tabular learners. Unlike existing methods that embed rows in isolation, CASE utilizes a contextualization strategy: we pre-fill the KV cache of a custom-trained Gemma 3-based Tabular Language Model with a representative sample of rows to establish a persistent anchor of the dataset's semantics. This ensures that generated row embeddings are dynamically contextualized, resolving semantic ambiguities and anchoring representations in domain-specific context. translated_title: 基于上下文感知语义嵌入的表格学习器增强方法
translated_abstract: 虽然现代表格学习器擅长捕捉统计模式，但它们常常在“语义真空”中运行，将文本特征视为离散符号，忽略了特征名称或单元格条目中蕴含的丰富语义。我们提出了CASE（上下文感知语义嵌入），这是一个新颖的框架，旨在弥合大型语言模型（LLM）的语义理解能力与表格学习器统计能力之间的鸿沟。与现有方法将行独立嵌入不同，CASE采用了一种上下文化策略：我们使用具有代表性的行样本预填充一个基于Gemma 3定制训练的表格语言模型的KV缓存，从而建立数据集语义的持久锚点。这确保了生成的行嵌入能够被动态上下文化，解决语义歧义，并将表示锚定在特定领域的上下文中。我们在多个基准测试（CARTE、TextTab等）上进行了实验……
tldr: 提出CASE框架，通过用代表性行样本预填充基于Gemma 3的表格语言模型的KV缓存来为表格行嵌入提供数据集级语义上下文，从而弥合大语言模型语义理解与表格学习器统计能力之间的差距，解决文本特征的语义歧义问题。
